1	# WP-005 — onPersonaPartials Hook Wiring in buildPersona()
     2	
     3	## Description
     4	
     5	Wire the `onPersonaPartials` hook into `buildPersona()` so that plugins can inject or override partials on a per-persona basis. The hook fires after `onBuildContext` (when the full context is available) but before template rendering. Each persona receives a shallow copy of the suite-level partials map to prevent cross-persona leakage.
     6	
     7	## Scope — Files to Modify
     8	
     9	- `src/builders/persona-builder.ts` — `buildPersona()` function, new step between `onBuildContext` and frontmatter rendering
    10	- Import of `runPersonaPartials` from `../plugins/runner.js`
    11	
    12	## Dependencies
    13	
    14	- WP-001 (Type Definitions Foundation)
    15	- WP-003 (Plugin Runner Functions — provides `runPersonaPartials`)
    16	- WP-004 (Config Partials and onPartials Hook Wiring — suite-level partials map is the input)
    17	
    18	## Active Pipeline Stages
    19	
    20	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    21	
    22	## Acceptance Criteria
    23	
    24	1. An `onPersonaPartials` plugin can inject a partial that is resolvable as `{{> partialName}}` in that persona's template
    25	2. An `onPersonaPartials` plugin can override a suite-level partial for a single persona
    26	3. Persona-level partial overrides do not leak to other personas in the same suite (shallow copy isolation)
    27	4. The hook receives the post-`onBuildContext` context, allowing plugins to inspect persona metadata
    28	5. The hook receives the current `target` value
    29	6. Project compiles without errors
    30	7. All existing tests continue to pass unchanged
    31	
    32	## Notes
    33	
    34	- The shallow copy (`{ ...partialsMap }`) is essential for isolation — the plan explicitly calls this out as a risk mitigation.
    35	- The hook fires between steps 3 and 4 of the current `buildPersona()` pipeline (becoming step 3.5).
    36	- `buildPersona()` creates a shallow copy of the suite-level `partialsMap` before calling `runPersonaPartials`.
    37	- The persona-local augmented partials map is used for that persona's rendering (step 6: `resolvePartials`).
    38	- Estimated complexity: Medium.

   513	// buildSuite — all personas in one suite × one target
   514	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   515	
   516	/**
   517	 * Build all personas in a suite for a single output target.
   518	 *
   519	 * Pipeline:
   520	 *   1. Load `_shared.yaml` for the suite
   521	 *   2. Load merged partials (config.partials → shared → suite-local)
   522	 *   3. Run `onSuiteInit` on all plugins
   523	 *   3a. Run `onPartials` on all plugins (highest priority: may override any file-based partial)
   524	 *   4. Discover all persona YAML files
   525	 *   5. Call `buildPersona()` for each
   526	 *
   527	 * @param suiteName    Identifier for this suite
   528	 * @param suiteConfig  Suite configuration
   529	 * @param config       Top-level BuildConfig
   530	 * @param plugins      Registered plugins
   531	 * @param target       Target output format
   532	 * @param agentMap     Pre-built cross-suite agent name map
   533	 * @param registry     Target registry to use. Defaults to `defaultRegistry`.
   534	 *   **Two-registry limitation:** If you pass a custom `TargetRegistry` only
   535	 *   to `build()` (via `config.targetRegistry`) and call `buildSuite()`
   536	 *   directly without also passing that registry here, your custom targets
   537	 *   will not be visible — `defaultRegistry` will be used instead. Either
   538	 *   pass the same registry instance explicitly, or call `build()` to have
   539	 *   the registry forwarded automatically.
   540	 * @returns            Array of BuildResult objects, one per persona
   541	 */
   542	export async function buildSuite(
   543	  suiteName: string,
   544	  suiteConfig: SuiteConfig,
   545	  config: BuildConfig,
   546	  plugins: PersonaBuildPlugin[],
   547	  target: string,
   548	  agentMap: Record<string, string> = {},
   549	  registry: TargetRegistry = defaultRegistry,
   550	): Promise<BuildResult[]> {
   551	  // ── 1. Load shared metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────
   552	  const metaSubdir = suiteConfig.metaSubdir ?? 'meta';
   553	  const sharedYamlPath = path.join(suiteConfig.srcDir, metaSubdir, '_shared.yaml');
   554	  const sharedMeta = await loadRawYaml(sharedYamlPath);
   555	
   556	  // ── 2. Load partials (three-layer: config.partials → shared → suite-local) ─
   557	  // Start with config.partials as the lowest-priority base layer.
   558	  let partialsMap: Record<string, string> = { ...(config.partials ?? {}) };
   559	
   560	  if (config.sharedPartialsDir && existsSync(config.sharedPartialsDir)) {
   561	    partialsMap = { ...partialsMap, ...(await loadPartials(config.sharedPartialsDir)) };
   562	  }
   563	
   564	  const partialsSubdir = suiteConfig.partialsSubdir ?? 'partials';
   565	  const suitePartialsDir = path.join(suiteConfig.srcDir, partialsSubdir);
   566	  if (existsSync(suitePartialsDir)) {
   567	    partialsMap = { ...partialsMap, ...(await loadPartials(suitePartialsDir)) };
   568	  }
   569	
   570	  // ── 3. Plugin onSuiteInit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
   571	  runSuiteInit(plugins, suiteConfig, sharedMeta);
   572	
   573	  // ── 3a. Plugin onPartials ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
   574	  // Invoked after onSuiteInit and after all file-based partials are loaded.
   575	  // Plugins may inject new partials or override any file-based entry.
   576	  partialsMap = runPartials(plugins, partialsMap, suiteName, suiteConfig);
   577	
   578	  // ── 4. Discover persona YAML files ────────────────────────────────────────
   579	  const personaYamlPaths = await discoverSuitePersonaYamls(suiteConfig);
   580	
   581	  // ── 5. Build each persona ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
   582	  const results: BuildResult[] = [];
   583	  for (const yamlPath of personaYamlPaths) {
   584	    const result = await buildPersona(
   585	      yamlPath,
   586	      suiteName,
   587	      suiteConfig,
   588	      sharedMeta,
   589	      partialsMap,
   590	      config,
   591	      plugins,
   592	      target,
   593	      agentMap,
   594	      registry,
   595	    );
   596	    results.push(result);
   597	  }
   598	
   599	  return results;
   600	}
